AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R19-04
NEXT ORDINANCE NO. O19-736
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
MAYOR’S REPORT – MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST
i.
Recognition of Chinese New Year
ii.
25 Year Commemoration of Officers Lost in the Line of Duty
CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 8a-f)
All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion, unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda. An applicant or interested citizen who wishes to appeal any Planning Commission decision (Item #8a-f) may file an appeal with the City Clerk's office within 15 days after the date of the Planning Commission's decision.
PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA
Speakers shall be provided up to 3 minutes to speak regarding all topics on the Consent Agenda.
1.
Waive Further Reading
Recommendation: After the City Attorney has read the title, waive full reading of ordinances considered on this agenda for introduction on first reading or adoption on second reading.
2.
Draft City Council Action Minutes - January 22, 2019
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
Minutes
3.
Demands of February 12, 2019
Recommendation: Approve payment of Motions #1 and #2.
a.
Motion #1 – Payroll Warrant of January 25, 2019 and February 8, 2019
b.
Motion #2 – Warrant Register of February 12, 2019
Demands
4.
Acceptance of Donations
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council accept the gifts as presented.
Staff Report
5.
Special Event Application for Palos Verdes Community Art Association Affiliates Summer Art Shows: April 13-14, May 18-19, June 15-16, July 20-21, August 17-18, September 21-22, 2019 from 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. on the Malaga Cove Plaza Green
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Special Event Application for Palos Verdes Community Art Association Affiliates Summer Shows scheduled one weekend per month from April through September, 2019.
Staff Report
6.
Consideration of Purchasing and Utilizing the GovInvest Platform for Projecting and Monitoring the City of Palos Verdes Estates Pension and Retiree Health Liabilities
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider subscribing with GovInvest software platform for projecting and monitoring the City's employee and retiree pension and medical costs and obligations for three-years at a cost of $36,000 and provide direction to staff.
Staff Report
7.
Consideration of Request by the Palos Verdes Golf Club for an Adjustment to the 2019 Annual Capital Improvement Fund Budget for Improvements to the Golf Club Facility
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider approving the Palos Verdes Golf Club request to adjust its budget by appropriating an additional $300,000 from their Capital Improvement Fund fund balance for facility improvements.
Staff Report
8.
Planning Commission Actions of January 15, 2019
Recommendation: Receive and file.
a.
M-1298-18; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for fencing exceeding the allowable height within the setback adjacent to the street at the single family residence located at 2765 Via Campesina. Lot 2, Block 1716, Tract 6885. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant/
Owner: Sunil Adwani
Actions: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Lazzaro absent) with standard conditions and the following additional condition: 1) Due to existing conditions along the right-of-way, the City takes no exception to the construction of the non-standard walkway.
b.
G-1627-18; Consideration of a Grading Application at the single family residence located at 2245 Via La Brea. Lot 17, Block 1635, Tract 7330. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Joseph Fournier Design, Inc.
362 Termino Ave.
Long Beach, CA 90814
Owner: Golnaz Eslami
Actions: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Lazzaro absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) New curb shall be constructed per City standards along the property frontage as approved by the City Engineer. 2) A new driveway approach shall be constructed per City standards as approved by the City Engineer. 3) Runoff from watershed tributary to the boundaries of the proposed project shall be intercepted and conveyed through the site to an approved drainage outlet/easement. 4) This project is considered Hillside Residential. Portions of the lot being graded/excavated exceed 25% grade; thus, the project shall comply with the City Ordinance and Municipal Code 13.08.060, Section C.
c.
NC-1644/G-1626/M-1293-18; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading & Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence located at 2915 Via La Selva. Lot 5, Tract 11235. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Jeffrey Dahl
1102 Main St
Huntington Beach, CA 92648
Owner: Jeffrey & Ingrid Axtell
Actions: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Lazzaro absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) The existing curb along the frontage of the property shall be removed and constructed, per the Via Valmonte PV Stone curb standard plan ST-29. 2) Runoff from watershed tributary to the boundaries of the proposed project shall be intercepted and conveyed through the site. 3) Approval from the Urban Forester must be obtained for the location of the proposed driveway due to its proximity to an existing Eucalyptus tree in the City right of way. 4) The project creates, adds or replaces more than 10,000 square feet of impervious surface and; thus, the project shall comply with the City's municipal NPDES permit and requirements set forth in Municipal Code 13.08.060, Section C. 5) The driveway and driveway approach on the public right-of-way shall be located 6 feet away from the closest Eucalyptus tree.
d.
NC-1645/CDP-114/G-1625/M-1290-18; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Coastal Development Permit, Grading & Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence located at 321 Rocky Point Road. Lot 3, Tract 17606. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Joseph Spierer Architects, Inc.
707 Torrance Blvd #100
Redondo Beach, CA 90277
Owner: Kurt & Laura Robinson
Actions: Approved the application (3-0 in favor, Criley abstained, Lazzaro absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) The proposed nonstandard driveways are approved. 2) The project creates, adds or replaces more than 10,000 square feet of impervious surface and; thus, the project shall comply with the City’s municipal NPDES permit and requirements set forth in Municipal Code 13.08.060, Section C. 3) The maximum ridge height shall not exceed 19 feet 10 inches from natural grade or existing grade, whichever is lower. 4) All trees shall be removed from the property, subject to approval from the Palos Verdes Homes Association. 5) Any new vegetation grown shall not exceed the lower ridge height of 14 feet.
e.
NC-1622-18; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility Application for a new single family residence located at 2640 Via Pacheco. Lot 6, Block 2317, Tract 6888. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Joseph Fournier Design, Inc.
362 Termino Ave.
Long Beach, CA 90814
Owner: Jason Whitehead
Actions: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Lazzaro absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) New curb shall be constructed per City standards along the property frontage as approved by the City Engineer. 2) All non-standard encroachments shall be removed from the right of way (brick walk, parkway, etc). 3) A new driveway shall be constructed per City standards as approved by City Engineer. 4) Approval from the Urban Forester must be obtained for the location of the proposed driveway due to its proximity to an existing tree in the City right-of-way.
f.
NC-1528R-18; Consideration of a revised Neighborhood Compatibility Application for revisions to walls previously approved at the single family residence located at 525 Via Almar. Lots 6 & 7, Block 1512, Tract 6886. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant/
Owner: Steven & Helen Lundblad
Actions: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Lazzaro absent) with standard conditions.
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to State law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING(S)
9.
Continued Request to Appeal Planning Commission Approval NC-1624/G-1617/M-1258-18; Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading Permit, and Miscellaneous Applications for Additions and Remodeling to the Single-Family Residence and Walls Exceeding the Allowable Height Located at 421 Via Media. Lots 12 & 13, Block 1511, Tract 6886. (Resolution No. PCR-2018-1070) (This Project is Exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.)
Recommendation: Continued to February 26, 2019.
Staff Report
10.
Request to Appeal Planning Commission Approval of NC-1528R-18; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility Revision for Structures Exceeding Allowable Height at the Single-Family Residence Located at 521 & 525 Via Almar. Lots 6 & 7, Block 1512, Tract 6886. (This project is Exempt from CEQA per California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.)
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council open the public hearing, receive public input, close the public hearing, and make a decision on the application.
Staff Report
11.
Introduction on First Reading of Ordinance 19-735 Amending Section 8.040.010 of Title 8 (Health and Safety) of the City’s Municipal Code and Memorandum of Understanding with Los Angeles County Department of Public Health Regarding Onsite Wastewater Treatment Systems
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council open the public hearing, receive public input, close the public hearing and introduce on first reading Ordinance 19-735, amending Section 8.040.010 of Title 8 (Health and Safety) of the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code by adopting by reference the Los Angeles County Health and Safety Code (Title 11).
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
12.
Consideration of Modification of City Ordinance Regulating Gas-Powered Blowers
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider the options for modifying the City’s existing noise ordinance to address the use of gas-powered blowers.
Staff Report
13.
Summary and Discussion for Providing Direction in Reference to the Meeting with City of Rancho Palos Verdes about its Finance Advisory Committee
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive an oral report from the Ad Hoc Committee consisting of Mayor Pro Tem Kao and Councilmember Vandever with input from the City Manager and Finance Director, and discuss the findings from the meeting with Rancho Palos Verdes to consider options and alternatives for the City to move forward.
Staff Report
14.
Consideration of Policy for Public Use of the City’s Council Chambers
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve and adopt the proposed Council Chambers Use Policy.
Staff Report
OLD BUSINESS
15.
Consideration of Proposed Deed Restrictions on Bluff Cove Properties (Located at 1009, 1015, 1017, 1101, 1105, 1117, and 1121 Palos Verdes Drive West)
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the form of the Deed restrictions as presented and authorize the Mayor to execute.
Staff Report
STAFF REPORTS
16.
City Manager's Report
MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS
17.
Ad Hoc Committee Reports
ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 26, 2019, AT 7:30 P.M. IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS FOR THE PURPOSE OF A REGULAR MEETING.
i.

Dated this 8th day of February, 2019.
